game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the ice mill.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the ice mill. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 14.
